integrity: Analytical proof supplied, finite-volume computations independently verify formulas; original finite-volume findings are not repurposed as infinite-dimensional proof. October 2026 motivating paper full text was inaccessible and may implicitly cover portions. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Results apply to athermal one-dimensional two-velocity particles with sticky walls and constant independent flip rate. A stationary finite-box observation is required before the infinite-size limit. No interaction, Brownian diffusion, wall softness or moving wall is covered.
title: Universal force-imbalance fluctuations and two-wall noise in a confined run-and-tumble gas
